# Go Green College Painters

## What We Are
Go Green College Painters is a student-owned, owner-operated painting company based in Greater Grand Rapids, Michigan. Founded in 2024 by siblings Jackson and Evelyn Befus, the company provides professional painting services for residential and commercial clients. All work is performed directly by the owners — not subcontracted.

## Services
- **Exterior Painting**: Full exterior house and building painting, including prep and cleanup, built to withstand Michigan weather.
- **Interior Painting**: Interior room painting with floor and furniture protection, clean lines, and zero mess left behind.
- **Deck Staining**: Deck and fence cleaning, sanding, and staining using premium products to protect and renew weathered wood. Surface refinishing only — board replacement and structural carpentry are not offered (small imperfections are patched with wood filler).
- **Custom Mural & Design**: Custom painted murals, accent walls, and creative color designs for children's rooms, dining rooms, and commercial spaces.

## Service Area
Greater Grand Rapids, Michigan and surrounding communities.

## Founders
**Jackson Befus** — Co-Owner & Project Manager. Studying Communications and Entrepreneurship at Michigan State University. Discovered his love of painting restoring his father's vintage 36' sailboat. Manages project operations and client relations.

**Evelyn Befus** — Co-Owner & Creative Director. Studying Industrial Design at Wayne State University. Lifelong artist and illustrator specializing in custom murals and creative painting projects.

## Why Go Green
- Owner-operated: Jackson and Evelyn do every job themselves, with no beginner crews.
- Fully insured on every job.
- Free, no-obligation estimates with transparent pricing.
- 100% satisfaction guarantee.
- Founded 2024. Serving Greater Grand Rapids.
